assertions.name: closed_forms_match_quadrature
assertions.source: arctan form (Whitehead, n=1) and arcsin form (Borromean, n=2) each agree with direct quadrature of van der Veen's Step-6 integral to better than 1e-25

assertions.name: step6_reduction_and_prefactor_validated
assertions.source: the Whitehead closed form reproduces an independent evaluation of the un-reduced 2-D Step-5 integral, which is the only place the derived prefactor C = 2 psi 2^(-n/2) enters

description: Evaluates in closed form the constant van der Veen (AGT 8 (2008) 603-624) leaves unevaluated in the proof of his Lemma 4 — the constant E in the colored-Jones asymptotic of a Whitehead chain, which is the object this corpus measures as c_sigma. His Step 6 reduces it to a 1-D integral of a Gaussian against erfc^n; that is an (n+1)-dimensional Gaussian orthant probability, elementary exactly for n <= 2, and the Whitehead link (n=1) and Borromean rings (n=2) are both inside that window. Gives arctan and arcsin closed forms, checked against quadrature to 1e-25 and, for the Whitehead link, against an independent evaluation of the un-reduced 2-D Step-5 integral. Does NOT yet give c_sigma: the bridge needs Lemma 3's S~_N constant and the J/J' normalisation, and the measured ratio is c-dependent, so it cannot be guessed from one link. Nothing fitted.

source.paper: van der Veen, Proof of the volume conjecture for Whitehead chains, Algebr. Geom. Topol. 8 (2008) 603-624
source.what_he_proves: the volume conjecture for the family, with D = 3 pi for b = 1 — the N-power, independent of the number of components
source.what_he_leaves: E, given as a (c+d+1)-dim Gaussian integral and self-reduced in Step 6 to one dimension; he shows only that it is nonzero
source.his_deferral: cites Gukov-Murakami for the conjecture that E is determined by the Ray-Singer torsion, and defers it to a subsequent publication
source.sequel_status: a literature search finds no such sequel — his later work moves to spin networks and then to algorithmic knot invariants; and no other author has published this constant for a multi-cusped link in this setting (colored Jones in S^3 at e^{2 pi i/N})

data.why_it_closes: each erfc is a half-space indicator integrated out, so the n-fold product against a Gaussian is an (n+1)-dimensional Gaussian ORTHANT probability. Elementary closed forms exist exactly for n <= 2 (bivariate/trivariate orthant); n >= 3 requires Plackett reduction and has none in general. The Whitehead link (n=1) and Borromean rings (n=2) are both inside that window — a Whitehead chain with more clasps would not be.

step5_step6_crosscheck.validates: the Step5 -> Step6 reduction AND the prefactor C = 2 psi 2^(-n/2), which is derived from van der Veen's text here rather than stated by him

bridge_to_c_sigma_NOT_done.missing: the constant in van der Veen's Lemma 3 for the maximal term S~_N, and the normalisation between J and the reduced J' this corpus measures
bridge_to_c_sigma_NOT_done.why_c_dependent_is_expected: S~_N enters the bridge raised to the (c+d) power, so the missing factor cannot be a single constant and cannot be inferred from one link
